text:
Priya (oncall): noticing a spike in GPU attach latency in us-west1, a bunch of pods stuck at Attaching >2m. correlates with host-local-io p50 jumping :thinking_face:
Alisa (storage): pulling SMART and iostat, devices report OK but io_wait and sync write queues spike. possible background maintenance window overlap
Raj (sre): did we change any cleaner/crons recently? we had that small-file trim cadence tweak yesterday
Tom (infra): we nudged the cleaner cron forward 5m to avoid a firmware rollout. targeted nodes with `scratch-high` label. might be colliding with provisioning waves
Alisa (storage): grabbed per-node logs, pattern looks like: burst of synchronous TRIMs -> writeback stalls -> nvme queue depth collapse. example:
```
[2026-03-22T03:05:10Z] cleaner: issuing 38k small TRIM ops
[2026-03-22T03:05:11Z] nvme0n1: avg_io_wait=280ms, qdepth->1
[2026-03-22T03:05:13Z] kubelet: attach timeout pod=gpu-job-12
```
Priya (oncall): can we short-circuit the cleaner on nodes handling attach traffic? immediate mitigation would be ideal
eng-cleaner-bot: temporarily suspending small-file trim job for nodes with `scratch-high` in us-west1. will auto-resume in 15m unless cleared. :white_check_mark:
Raj (sre): also raise local ioQuota on the affected nodepool to provide headroom so kubelet attach can progress. Priya, can you push that change?
Priya (oncall): running `kubectl patch nodepool us-west1-high --patch '{"spec":{"ioQuota":"2x"}}'` now. watching the attach queue
metrics-bot: host-local-io-latency (p50) rose 3ms->135ms at 03:05; attach-failures increased 0->21 within 3m
Tom (infra): rolling the cleaner cron back to original window and adding a quick guard: cleaner checks `kube-provision-load` before starting bursts. patch queued to ops-config
Alisa (storage): long-term proposals: 1) make cleaner issue TRIMs in async batches rather than sync bursts 2) add a safety gate: if attach_pending > 5 then delay trims 3) improve SMART thresholds, current fw doesn't flag rising latency reliably
Raj (sre): agree. i'll schedule a remediation job to run quick fs/device scans on hosts that recorded qdepth collapse — some devices logged transient corruption flags even though SMART passed
Priya (oncall): after pause + ioQuota bump attach backlog cleared. monitoring for 30m. thanks folks :relieved:
Tom (infra): created infra ticket IR-2026-0421: "Cleaner burst overlapping provisioning causing NVMe writeback stalls -> GPU attach backlog" with action items and cost/availability tradeoffs. note: pausing trims delays garbage work and mildly increases wear risk but preserves provisioning SLA
Alisa (storage): adding a rule to the device-health runbook: if p50 io-latency >50ms AND attach_pending >10 -> auto-pause cleaner and page oncall
Priya (oncall): acknowledged. will update if it reappears
